name: Voidunmake Touch
description: Touch a spark or a thread of qi in the air and unmake it before it can grow.

name: Erase Palm
description: Strike with a palm that rubs out the qi at the point of contact.

name: Cancel Spark
description: Cancel a small flame or flash of qi with a flick of the emptied palm.

name: Hollowing Blow
description: Hit a limb with a blow that hollows out its strength for a few breaths.

name: Blank Sense
description: Feel for a spot where qi has been unmade to learn that a technique was used nearby.

name: Unmaking Strike
description: Land a full palm that strips a ward or a layer of armour qi from the target.

name: Qi Strip
description: Draw the qi out of the limb of a foe in a single pass so the limb hangs weak.

name: Null Pulse
description: Send a pulse of nothing through the ground that drains the footing and the strength of those it crosses.

name: Annul Strike
description: Drive an emptied palm through the guard of a foe and annul the shield qi in one blow.

name: Unmaking Surge
description: Roll a wave of unmaking outward that strips the wards and strength from all it touches.

name: Deadened Hush
description: Lay a deadening hush over the near air so that chants and sparks both fade.

name: Null Mark
description: Mark the edge of the null field and learn who enters it.

name: Null Ring
description: Draw a ring of nothing round the user so that thrown things lose their force at the rim.

name: Null Flick
description: Flick a pellet of nothing that unmakes a patch of cloth and skin where it lands.

name: Wide Hush
description: Spread the hush across the field so that weak techniques cannot be made in it.

name: Hollowing Purge
description: Empty a field of foul qi and curse residue and leave the allies in it clean.

name: Dead Ring
description: Throw a ring of dead air that spoils the rhythm of qi in everyone it crosses.

name: Nullifying Shroud
description: Hold a great field in which the techniques thrown at the user and allies come apart into plain air.

name: Silencing Wave
description: Cast the null field across a wide stretch of ground and let no technique form there.

name: Twin Voids
description: Hold a hollow in each hand and clap them over the head of an opponent to jar the senses.

name: Paired Blank
description: Cross two blank palms before the chest to cancel a bolt of qi coming from either side.

name: Dual Hush
description: Press a hush from each hand into two casters at once.

name: Twingap Sense
description: Read the gap left by two vanished qi signs and judge how far apart the unseen casters stand.

name: Cross Nothing
description: Cross two voids on the target so that the blow is felt in the space between them.

name: Voidpair Seal
description: Seal the qi in two limbs of a foe with a palm on each.

name: Dual Annul
description: Hold both voids out and annul a heavy technique that comes from the front.

name: Twinvoid Collapse
description: Let the two voids fall in on each other and pull a ring of ground and air into the gap.

name: Absence Thrust
description: Draw a line of nothing along the body of an opponent and strike where the line ends.

name: Track Hush
description: Run a hush along the first track to still the qi at the end of it.

name: Void Thread
description: Cast a thread of nothing along the second track at the foe.

name: Duotrack Sense
description: Read two separate dead zones at the same moment and tell them apart.

name: Mirror Null
description: Face the blow with a pane of nothing that wipes its qi away.

name: Cross Blank
description: Cross the tracks into a blank guard that holds against a spear thrust.

name: Parallel Null
description: Hold two tracks of nothing on two foes and keep both under a quieting weight.

name: Absence Wash
description: Draw a poison or a binding into one track and empty it out through the other.

name: Double Nothing
description: Strike once with a hand that is empty and again with a hand that is emptier.

name: Dual Absence
description: Run both tracks over the field until the strength drains out of everything between them.

name: Track Collapse
description: Collapse the tracks inward on a single foe and seal the qi of the foe inside the gap.

name: Sworn Silence
description: Swear a silence over the area round the user and let no spark rise in it.

name: Vow Hush
description: Speak the vow without sound and let a thrown flame go out before it reaches the user.

name: Silence Palm
description: Strike with a sworn palm that carries no sound of impact.

name: Oath Gap
description: Hold the oath and notice any gap in the silence where another sound or qi has crept in.

name: Hush Ward
description: Raise a ward of hush over an ally so a blow lands without force.

name: Voidoath Seal
description: Seal the qi of a foe in place with an oath that holds as long as the user stays silent.

name: Silence Lock
description: Lock a caster in silence so the words and gestures of the casting fall into nothing.

name: Oathvoid Step
description: Step away from a blow by stepping into a gap the oath has opened.

name: Vow Annulment
description: Stake the vow against a great technique and annul it in the instant it forms.

name: Sworn Stillness
description: Cast the sworn stillness over a whole line of foes and let none of them move or strike.

name: Open Nothing
description: Open a patch of nothing before a charging foe so that the footing fails.

name: Boundless Hush
description: Let the hush widen without edge and quieten all qi that enters it.

name: Gapwide Sense
description: Read the whole empty reach round the user for signs of anything that disturbs it.

name: Open Blank
description: Open a blank before the user into which blows are swallowed.

name: Endless Null
description: Hold a null that has no limit and feed it until no technique can rise inside it.

name: Open Voidwash
description: Wash a curse or foul qi from allies in the open and let it vanish without trace.

name: Unbound Void
description: Burst a hollow wide across the ground so that those within it stagger and weaken.

name: Unwalled Void
description: Cast a void with no wall and no end over the field and press all strength down inside it.

name: Boundless Annul
description: Spread an annulling nothing across the whole front and erase the techniques that cross it.
